name: get_pubchem_compound_info
description: Fetch detailed compound information from the PubChem database using a PubChem Compound ID (CID). Returns the compound's SMILES representation, molecular formula, and synonyms. Use this tool when you have a specific CID (e.g. '2244') and need detailed information about that compound. Do NOT use this tool for searching compounds by name or other identifiers; use 'search_pubchem_by_name' for that purpose.

parameters.name: cid
parameters.description: The PubChem Compound ID, a positive integer representing the unique identifier for the compound (e.g. 2244). Must be a valid CID; the function raises an error if not found.

parameters.name: include_synonyms
parameters.description: Whether to include a list of synonyms for the compound in the response. Set to false to reduce response size if synonyms are not needed. Defaults to true.

smiles.description: SMILES representation of the compound, a textual representation of its structure.

molecular_formula.description: Molecular formula of the compound, indicating the number of each type of atom.

synonyms.description: List of synonyms for the compound, only present if include_synonyms=true.

return_schema.description: Compound metadata including CID, SMILES, molecular formula, and optional synonyms.
